files.scope_note: Not in the original 2-file family-6 scope. Added after verification proved it is a hard runtime prerequisite for ember_c_e2b_paired_run.py's primary --dry-run functional path (score_ember_work_leg_v1 imports it directly, unconditionally, on leg 1 -- the very first computation the dry-run performs). Landing the pair without it means the pair's own primary self-check cannot run at all, which is the scope reduction, not the inclusion. Team-lead ruling: same class as the family-4/5 harness-entry resequencing, applied within a single PR rather than across families since this file belongs to no other named family.

pre_existing_defects_disclosed.summary: ember_c_e2b_paired_run.py --dry-run leg 1 (ember_work) completes fully with real computed scores: owned(cited)=0.40, e2b(trained)=1.20. Leg 2 (founder_likeness) then raises the SAME tokenizer/tokenizer.json defect already tracked against issue #776 (Exception: token out-of-vocabulary at a fixed line/column in the merge table) -- not #778, which tracks a separate config-drift/inf-perplexity cluster found in family j. Not introduced by this landing; recurrence only, no re-disclosure needed per team-lead's prior ruling on this defect class.

ember_e2b_surpass_run.py --selftest: 4 of its checks report SELFTEST FAIL (surpass-fixture round-trip, distance-fixture round-trip, invalid-fixture round-trip, vet_c14_receipt positive control). All 4 trace to the external goalforge sibling worktree's own broken state (resolved via EMBER_GOALFORGE_ROOT, see below), not to anything landed here: a ModuleNotFoundError for a module that genuinely does not exist in that tree (confirmed via directory listing), and separately a UnicodeDecodeError inside that tree's own test_c0.py. The resolution path (EMBER_GOALFORGE_ROOT env var, computed default) is already correctly portable in the landed file; the failures are the external tree's live state, out of scope for this landing. Other selftest sections in the same run pass cleanly: --live refusal proofs (2 PASS), write_or_diagnose invalid-token test (1 PASS), adapter-file checkpoint-contract coverage (6 PASS: round-trip, sha-mismatch refusal, zero-delta refusal, resolve_c14_checkpoint shapes x2, build_fp16_adapter measurement), and the vet_c14_receipt BLOCKED-fixture negative control (1 PASS).
